mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_escalation_log (ticket_id, timer_id, rule_name, action, from_priority, to_priority, notify_to, success, error_msg) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{timerId}, #{ruleName}, #{action}, #{fromPriority}, #{toPriority}, #{notifyTo}, #{success}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, timer_id, rule_name, action, from_priority, to_priority, notify_to, success, error_msg, create_time FROM sla_escalation_log WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id DESC
